pages.text: This entry contains $(thing)TFE$() features that do not belong in an existing TFC chapter. Changes to existing TFC systems are no longer duplicated here; use $(l:new_terra_earth/ported_crops)Changes to TFC$() in this category to jump to their standard Field Guide pages.

pages.title: Climate and Seasons
pages.text: The world still uses TFC's $(thing)Calendar$() and $(thing)Climate$() screens. TFE backports 1.21 semantics for average and current temperature, average and current rainfall, and seasonal variation to 1.20. These readings affect weather, world generation, and plant growth.

$(l:the_world/climate#temperature)Temperature$() varies with latitude, elevation, season, and time of day. Groundwater and hydration also depend on average rainfall, nearby rivers, and surface conditions. Wild plants use elevation-adjusted average temperature for generation, while cultivated plants grow using runtime climate.

pages.title: Terrain Families
pages.text: TFE adds terrain families for coasts and deep oceans, arid landforms, karst, volcanoes, glaciers, and ice sheets. They are selected together with temperature, rainfall, distance from the sea, hotspot age, and rock conditions rather than acting as isolated decorative biomes.

$(bold)Coasts and Oceans$(): bays, tidal flats, rocky shores, sea stacks, reefs, deep oceans, and trenches.$(br2)$(bold)Landforms$(): badlands, canyons, mesas, dune seas, salt flats, karst lakes, and sinkholes.$(br2)$(bold)High-energy Terrain$(): multi-stage volcanoes, ice sheets, subglacial lakes, glacial mountains, and eroded glacial terrain.

pages.title: Stove
pages.text: The $(thing)Stove$() is a variant of the $(thing)Firepit$() that will not ignite nearby blocks. It provides the firepit's main functions and accepts a pot, but it cannot accept a grill.
